About the Opportunity:

The Online Coding Hackathon is a two-round competitive programming event designed to provide students with an opportunity to demonstrate and strengthen their coding, logical reasoning, algorithmic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

The event will be conducted entirely online and will provide participants with a structured and competitive environment to test their programming skills against challenging coding problems.

The competition will consist of two coding rounds:

Round 1 – Easy-Level Coding Challenge:

The first round will assess participants' fundamental programming and problem-solving abilities through easy-level coding problems. Participants will be evaluated automatically based on the correctness of their submitted solutions and the test cases successfully passed.

Round 2 – Advanced Coding Challenge:

Participants who qualify from Round 1 will progress to the second round, which will include more challenging coding problems requiring efficient algorithms, logical reasoning, and optimized solutions.

The event is intended to encourage competitive programming, analytical thinking, continuous learning, and practical application of programming concepts.

Participants will have the opportunity to compete for prizes, earn recognition, and receive certificates according to the event guidelines.

  • Mode: Online
  • Participation: Individual
  • Rounds: 2
  • Platform: Online Coding Platform
  • Target Participants: Students and Aspiring Programmers

Online Coding Hackathon – Code. Compete. Conquer.

Are you ready to challenge your coding and problem-solving skills?

The Online Coding Hackathon is a two-round programming competition designed for students who are passionate about coding, algorithms, data structures, and logical problem-solving.

The competition provides participants with an opportunity to solve timed coding challenges, compete with programmers from different institutions, improve their programming skills, and earn recognition for their performance.

Competition Format:

The competition will be conducted in two rounds.

Round 1 – Easy-Level Coding Challenge:

Round 1 will focus on fundamental programming and problem-solving skills.

Participants will be provided with a set of easy-level coding problems and will be required to submit their solutions within the specified time limit.

Problems may cover topics such as:

  • Basic programming.
  • Arrays.
  • Strings.
  • Loops and conditional statements.
  • Functions.
  • Searching.
  • Sorting.
  • Basic mathematical and logical problems.

Solutions will be automatically evaluated using predefined test cases.

Participants who meet the announced qualification criteria will advance to Round 2.

Round 2 – Advanced Coding Challenge:

The shortlisted participants will compete in Round 2, which will feature more challenging programming problems.

Participants will be evaluated primarily on the correctness and efficiency of their solutions.

Rules:

  • Participation is individual unless otherwise specified.
  • Participants must register using their own valid details.
  • Each participant is permitted to register only once.
  • Participants must use their own account for the competition.
  • Participants must complete each round within the prescribed time.
  • Only qualified participants will be permitted to participate in Round 2.
  • Participants must submit their own solutions.
  • Sharing solutions or source code with other participants during the competition is prohibited.
  • Plagiarism, unauthorized collaboration, or copying of solutions may result in disqualification.
  • Participants must not attempt to exploit or interfere with the coding platform.
  • The organizers may review suspicious submissions before finalizing the results.
  • Participants are responsible for ensuring a stable internet connection and compatible device.
  • The organizers reserve the right to modify the schedule or guidelines if required and will communicate any significant changes through official channels.
  • The decision of the organizing committee regarding eligibility, qualification, and final results will be subject to the published competition guidelines.

Evaluation:

Submissions will be automatically evaluated against predefined test cases.

Evaluation may consider:

  • Correctness.
  • Test cases successfully passed.
  • Execution time.
  • Memory usage.
  • Algorithmic efficiency.

Qualification:

Participants will be shortlisted for Round 2 according to the qualification criteria announced by the organizers.

The Round 2 leaderboard will be used to determine the final ranking.

Prizes & Recognition:

Top-performing participants will receive prizes and recognition as announced by the organizers.

Certificates may be provided to eligible participants, including participants who qualify for Round 2 and finalists, according to the event guidelines.

Important:

Participants should carefully read all event instructions before starting each round.

Get ready to Code. Compete. Conquer.
